subject: Kickoff cadence + demo deep-dive — Brightline trial readiness
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff cadence + demo deep-dive — Brightline trial readiness

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap (from our discovery): Brightline wants to pilot Redwood to accelerate triage suggestions in your clinician workflow. Priority metrics: suggestion precision at top-3, average latency under 250ms for short queries, and clear data retention controls.
- Next meeting: Technical deep-dive + evaluation kickoff (we'll confirm the trial plan, success criteria, and the initial prompt set/evals).
- Prep we need from your side: list of 3–5 representative prompts (anonymized), and a primary eval owner.

Proposed 60-minute slots (all PT):
- Tue 9/19 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 9/20 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 9/21 09:00–10:00 PT (we also reserved an ops slot if you want a separate procurement sync)

I've attached a short trial charter template and a sample prompt pack to make prep easier. If you prefer, we can do a 45-minute technical deep-dive + 15-minute mutual action planning follow-up. Monica (CS) and Ben (solutions) are looped to cover trial configuration and success metric tracking.

Tell me which slot works or suggest two alternatives and I'll send a calendar invite and a concise prework checklist.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: trial-charter-template.pdf (2 pages), sample-prompt-pack.csv (example prompts, anonymized)

From: Elaine Turner <elaine@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Brightline Health Procurement <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 17:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff cadence + demo deep-dive — Brightline trial readiness

Hi Mina — thanks for the clear recap. The team is aligned and we can do Wed 9/20 14:00–15:00 PT. A few quick asks ahead of the kickoff: 

1) Can you share a minimal success criteria template we can review with clinical ops? (precision/recall targets, latency SLOs, and data residency notes)
2) Who will run the initial prompt evals on your side vs. ours? We can own the anonymized prompt set and run the first pass if that's helpful.
3) Procurement will need a short note on expected data flows for the trial — can procurement be on the kickoff call or should that be a separate follow-up?

I attached a calendar hold for 9/20. Looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Elaine Turner
Head of Clinical Innovation | Brightline Health
elaine@brightlinehealth.com

Subject: Re: Kickoff cadence + demo deep-dive — Brightline trial readiness

Thanks Elaine — Wed 9/20 14:00–15:00 PT is locked from our side. Quick responses to your asks: 

1) Success criteria template: attached ("trial-charter-template.pdf"). It includes suggested thresholds for suggestion precision (baseline + target), latency SLOs, and data handling notes. We'll tailor those during the kickoff with clinical ops.
2) Prompt eval ownership: we're flexible — Redwood can run the initial evals to generate a baseline and heatmap, then Brightline can run the subsequent blinded validation. Practically, Monica will coordinate the initial runs and share results in Drive.
3) Procurement: happy to have procurement on the kickoff — that saves a separate meeting. We'll keep procurement's agenda item short (data flows, trial duration, access).

Prework checklist (short):
- Brightline: 3–5 anonymized prompts + one sample record schema (if available) — drop to the linked Drive folder.
- Redwood: will share trial plan PDF, baseline eval run, and a short runbook for CS.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-kickoff
Calendar invite (confirmed): https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/brightline-kickoff-20280921
HubSpot: hubspot:deal:BR-2028-0914

I'll send the calendar invite from my account with the agenda and attach the trial charter. Monica — can you own the baseline run and the initial eval report? Ben — can you confirm whether we should run a small quantized model demo for latency testing during the session?

Thanks all,

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.ai

Mina / Monica — quick confirmation: I'm available for the 9/20 slot. I recommend we show a short latency comparison (hosted small-quantized variant vs standard) during the demo — 10 minutes max, using a 5-query batch to show median p50/p95. That will help procurement and clinical ops see economics + latency tradeoffs.

Also, Monica, if you want I can prepare a one-pager with trial checkpoints (week 1 baseline, week 2 tuning, week 4 acceptance) to include in the kickoff deck.

Elaine — happy to stay on for procurement questions.

Ben Carter
